title: Camera docs contradict the unchanged code: ~67° is now 'shallowest' where the same fixed tilt was 'steep (~66 deg)', and 'varies with pad' is impossible for ortho zoom
evidence:
-    # orthographic, the MM top-down tilt: steep (~66 deg) — the roof reads AND
-    # a sliver of the south wall gives the flat extruded base
+    # orthographic, the MM top-down tilt (varies ~49-67° with the per-sprite
+    # pad — the roof carries the read on every sprite)
+- **W4** — camera contract states the REAL range **~49–67°** (varies with the
+per-sprite pad; campus ≈49° steepest, pucks ≈67° shallowest — measured from
+the bbox projections) in the spec §0, README, and docstring.
detail: Only the comment changed; camera code is untouched. Old text: one 'steep (~66 deg)' tilt. New text: ~67° is 'shallowest' and tilt 'varies with the per-sprite pad' — ortho zoom cannot alter projection angle; the conventions conflict.
recommended_fix: State the single tilt actually set in setup() under one angle convention; delete the 'varies with the per-sprite pad' claim from docstring, spec §0, and README.

title: Validation bbox table is geometrically impossible: puck_1/2/3 aspect spread 1.09–1.19 cannot occur for coplanar scaled discs under one camera and pad
evidence:
+  | puck_1/2/3 | 158/180/202 wide | 1.09–1.19 | discs, tier ladder |
+    r = PUCK_R * PUCK_TIER[ports]
+    add_cyl(name + "_o", (0, 0, OUTLINE_H / 2), r + OUTLINE_RING, OUTLINE_H, mat_hex(name + "_outline_m", OUTLINE_HEX))
+    add_flat_disc(name + "_disc", r, FILL_Z, PUCK_FILL)
+    shot(sc, name, 0.95)
detail: All three pucks are coplanar discs at FILL_Z under one fixed camera and one pad (0.95); only radius scales with tier. Projected aspect must be identical across tiers — a 1.09–1.19 spread is impossible.
recommended_fix: Re-measure the real bboxes from one render and correct the table (and the tilt range back-computed from it); don't ship validation numbers that cannot be reproduced.

title: Module docstring and README list export names in an order that contradicts the SPRITE_ORDER pin this PR exists to enforce
evidence:
+Output: assets/sprites/{house_0..3, host, dc, small_biz, campus, puck_1..3}.png
+`house_0..3.png`, `host.png`, `dc.png`, `small_biz.png`, `campus.png`,
+`puck_1..3.png` — land in `../sprites/`. `sprites.json` (the content bboxes)
+SPRITE_ORDER = [
+    "house_0", "house_1", "house_2", "house_3", "host", "dc",
+    "puck_1", "puck_2", "puck_3", "small_biz", "campus",
+]
detail: SPRITE_ORDER and the pin run house, host, dc, puck_1..3, small_biz, campus. The docstring and README enumerate small_biz/campus before the pucks — the same order-drift class Perkins r1 B1 flagged.
recommended_fix: List the eleven names in SPRITE_ORDER sequence in both the docstring and the README, matching spec §2's list.

title: add_outline docstring says its top is 'flush at the fill's base', but the plate top (0.02) sits 0.01 below FILL_Z (0.03)
evidence:
+    the fill footprint, its top flush at the fill's base — visible as a thin
+    add_cube(name + "_o", (cx, cy, OUTLINE_H / 2), (fw + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, fd + 2 * OUTLINE_RING, OUTLINE_H),
+OUTLINE_H    = 0.02   # outline plate thickness
+FILL_Z       = 0.03   # the flat fill plane (above the outline top)
detail: The plate spans z 0–0.02 (top at OUTLINE_H); flat fills and puck discs sit at FILL_Z=0.03. 'Flush' is false for every flat type; only the gable eaves (base_z=OUTLINE_H) are flush.
recommended_fix: Reword the docstring ('fill floats 0.01 above the plate') or name the offset with an explicit FILL_GAP constant; do not set FILL_Z=OUTLINE_H (coplanar z-fight).
